news.title: 85-year-old woman injured in southeast Atlanta double shooting
news.summary: A Monday afternoon shooting near Browns Mill Road SE and Lindsey Drive SE left an 84-year-old bystander and a 21-year-old man injured, according to Atlanta police.

news.title: Attorney seeks lower charges for mother accused of leaving baby in hot car
news.summary: A Gwinnett County mother faces a judge Tuesday following the death of her son, allegedly left in a hot car for nine hours.

news.title: Delta plane met by police following argument between passenger, flight attendant
news.summary: Police met a Delta flight arriving at Atlanta's airport after a passenger and flight attendant had a physical altercation.

news.title: McDonald's threat led to Bartow County deputy shooting
news.summary: A Bartow County deputy fired their weapon Tuesday morning after responding to a report of a person pulling a gun on an employee at a McDonald's on Joe Frank Harris Parkway SE.

news.title: Atlanta felon sentenced to 15 years for dealing fentanyl
news.summary: Reginald Pierce, a twice-convicted felon from Atlanta, has been sentenced to 15 years for dealing fentanyl while possessing an automatic weapon linked to a shooting.

news.title: Atlanta police auditing use of Flock license plate reader system
news.summary: Atlanta police are auditing employee use of the Flock license plate reader system.

news.title: ‘This was a reckless incident’: 85-year-old innocent bystander injured in double shooting
news.summary: Atlanta investigators identified a suspect vehicle following shootings that left an elderly woman and a young man hurt.

news.title: 1 dead, 1 critical, driver arrested after crash shuts down I-85 for hours
news.summary: Interstate 85 has reopened after being shut down for hours in Jackson County.

news.title: 85-year-old woman hurt in Atlanta double shooting
news.summary: A 21-year-old man was also injured in the shooting, according to Atlanta Police.

news.title: Atlanta Police announce two arrests in death of infant girl in May
news.summary: APD said Monday that James Hayes was arrested and faces second degree murder and child cruelty counts, while Kennedi Ponder is charged with child cruelty.
